spellbook.finance/limitations: limit bounds complete order groups. PostgreSQL keyset-selects eligible groups before hydrating their lines; the query can still inspect eligible candidates, and one selected order can contain many line rows.
This is a current SpellBook pull-session read. It may omit marketplace sales that have not been imported into SpellBook, so an empty page is not proof that no marketplace orders await shipment.
Incomplete sessions outside the active manifest window are omitted; found, unshipped work remains visible. Follow every page cursor before describing the work returned by this tool.
The lines reflect separate changing reads, not one transaction. Re-read before relying on state after the seller changes an order.
A found state records the seller's resolution in SpellBook. It does not prove a card is in its tray slot, package, or shipment. This tool does not report route optimization or shipping confirmation.
The response omits buyer names, addresses, inventory item ids, postage labels, and shipment credentials.

description: Read a page of SpellBook's current fulfillment work, grouped by marketplace order. Each order carries its tray slot and card lines with bin, printing, condition, and state, including blocked reasons and ship-by evidence when available. Use when a seller asks what to pull or pack. Read spellbook_skill for fulfilling-orders before coaching the workflow; follow nextCursor until hasMore is false before summarizing the full returned workset. Use pending lines for the shared bin walk, then verify and pack each order separately.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it unchanged to continue; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum complete order groups to return on this page, from 1 to 50. Omit for 20.

marketplace.description: Filter to one marketplace, or use all for the combined bin walk. Omit for all.

workspaceId.description: The seller-owned workspace to read, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_pull_work
